name: Cunedda

attributes.attribute: counted among the early settlers of Wales
its ruling lines carry his name

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

okr.objective: Cunedda is a Welsh hero regarded as one of the early settlers of Wales.
key_results: He is placed among the original settlers of Wales.
He arrived together with his eight sons.
He founded the Celtic kingdoms of the region.
The ruling lines of Gwynedd take their name from him.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
